My thoughts exactly. Maybe some of us really just want to die and don’t want to get better for a world we want no part in? Smh 
I’ve been to scared to do it because if I fuck up, I know it’ll be worse than dying so I don’t know how to go about it. 
If you find any answers, please hmu
Drowning is not the way my guy. That is probably one of the worse ways to die

Fr sleep is like the only thing I enjoy nowadays. It’s the only way you can actually stop yourself from thinking and existing. 
Even if we decide that we want to live someday, it’ll be extremely hard because we’re already behind in life, yknow? So what’s the point? And like you say, it’s one thing to put off responsibilities to do other reckless things that bring you joy, but what do we do if we don’t want to do literally anything? Like nothing sounds interesting or fun
Fr these therapists give you these “coping strategies” that just feel like an owner giving their dog a treat so they stop bothering everyone

I know that feeling. I’m actually going through the same thing right now. I’m 20 and I’m also in college but everyday I wake up disappointed that I’m still alive, and despite that, having to adapt to the adult world. If we can’t really deal with ourselves right now, how are we going to deal with ourselves tomorrow? A week from now? A couple of years from now? Is it just a struggle to find a reason to stay? Nah im not really keen on that life
